caseName: Renegotiation Board v. Bannercraft Clothing Co.
caseNameFull: Renegotiation Board v. Bannercraft Clothing Co., Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, 410 U. S. 907.] Motion of Sears, Roebuck & Co. for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted, and motion for leave to postpone oral argument denied.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
